gaps.lead: He was driving too fast, so he crashed.
gaps.sentence: He wouldn't have crashed if he ___ so fast.
gaps.explanation: If + past perfect continuous: hadn't been driving.

gaps.lead: It's a pity I didn't bring an umbrella.
gaps.explanation: Regret about the past: wish + past perfect — I wish I had brought.

gaps.lead: The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.answer: should have told / ought to have told
gaps.lead: It's a pity you didn't tell me earlier.
gaps.explanation: should/ought to have + participle expresses past regret/advice.

gaps.lead: I would love to afford a bigger flat.
gaps.explanation: wish + subject + could = regret about ability/possibility.

gaps.lead: He didn't pass the exam because he hadn't studied.
gaps.sentence: If he ___ , he would have passed the exam.
gaps.explanation: Third conditional: if + past perfect, would have + participle.
